description: C# bindings for Raven, a lightweight, multithreaded GUI library in C for editors and tools. The native library is included for Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS (arm64 and x64).

Host-neutral engine behind the Shiny gauge controls — value-to-angle scale mapping for any start angle and sweep, nice-number tick generation, a fit-to-box layout that sizes semicircle and three-quarter dials to the space they are given, and the spring/ease needle physics (momentum carried through…
